# ML-DSA (FIPS 204) known-answer vectors from NIST's ACVP server test files.
#   repository: https://github.com/usnistgov/ACVP-Server
#   commit:     975de31eb83d87039ec88934fdc47d8c312b892d (RELEASE/v1.1.0.43, 2026-08-12)
#   retrieved:  2026-09-15 from raw.githubusercontent.com at that commit
#   files:      gen-val/json-files/ML-DSA-keyGen-FIPS204/internalProjection.json
#               gen-val/json-files/ML-DSA-sigGen-FIPS204/internalProjection.json
#               gen-val/json-files/ML-DSA-sigVer-FIPS204/internalProjection.json
#   (internalProjection.json is the prompt joined with the expected results;
#   every value below is copied from it unchanged, upper-case hex as printed.)
#
# The cases are drawn from the groups this crate can drive through its public
# API: the pure (not pre-hashed) external signature interface, that is
# ML-DSA.Sign and ML-DSA.Verify with a context string (FIPS 204 Algorithms 2
# and 3). Each case names its test group and test case (tgId/tcId).
#
# KEYGEN_<set>_<i>: seed xi; the expected pk and sk (Algorithm 6 via Algorithm 1).
# SIGGEN_DET_<set>_<i>: deterministic variant (rnd = 0^32) with a context.
# SIGGEN_HEDGED_<set>_<i>: hedged variant with the rnd the file supplies.
# SIGVER_<set>_<i>: pk, message, context, signature and the expected verdict
#   (PASSED=true/false) with NIST's reason string; every reason is represented.
